headline: The two outer-involution classes have exact dual finite-geometric meanings. The 36-class is canonically the 36 spreads; the 540-class is canonically the 540 unordered disjoint-line pairs with four common transversals.

class540.geometry: two disjoint hub lines plus four pairwise-disjoint common transversals; intersection graph K2,4
class540.bijection: t -> the two degree-4 hub lines in Fix_lines(t)

bridge: The 36-spread count and BT748 540-fibre count are the two outer-involution orbits of the same PGSp(4,3) extension, distinguished by centralizers 720 and 48.
scope: Exact enumeration of all spreads, all disjoint line pairs, and every outer involution. No amplitude or physical interpretation is assumed.
